system.description:
“And you think we are just gonna hand over the client?” Diane asks her assailants who are surrounding her traveling party. “You seem to think you have the leeway to respond to my demands with a question little girl?” The Black-haired Bandit says with a condescending scowl. “That’s Genin, to you, whoever you are. But I think you better move, before I get mad, your people end up burned and boiled” She responds with an aggravated look in her eye. The bandits attack her for her statements. She inhales and exhales a gas of boiling hot steam, that creates a stream of screams from her would be assailants that slowly, but surely, goes silent.

—Lyo Hataka

At Worlds End, Ch. 2 excerpt.

A Corrosive Breath

The Futton Clan is a clan without a clear family name, but one with a deadly history and purpose. Members of this clan can be found in villages across the country, and are used to great effect in different military institutions. The Futton Family line is one that has a clear influence in Kirigakure (The Land of Water), even having one of its descendants as the Mizukage at one point in time. This clan uses its acidic Jutsu to melt the competition.

Futton Traits

Recommended Ability Score Increase: +2 Int or Str, +1 Con

Speed: 30 feet.

Skill Proficiencies: Martial Arts, and your choice between Ninshou or Athletics.

Boil Release Affinity: You begin with either Water or Fire Release Affinity. (Pick one)

Corrosive Techniques: The Futton Clan has access to a separate list of Jutsu unique to their Clan. You can add these Jutsu to your jutsu list instead of selecting jutsu from the Normal jutsu list(s). They do not need both Nature Release’s to use their Clan jutsu.

Hijutsu Flexibility: Futton Clan Hijutsu can use either Strength or Constitution as its casting ability score.

Branch Family: The Futton are split between two different branches, the [Corrosive Branch] and the [Broil Branch]. The corrosive branch are fighters who specialize in using the acidic vapors of Boil release to dissolve anything in their path. The broil branch are fighters who boil the chakra in their own body to build pressure for explosive martial arts. Select which branch your character is a part of. This determines some clan features or which Hijutsu you gain/have access to. This cannot be changed later.

Futton Features

Corrosive Kisses

1st Level Clan Feature, [Corrosive Branch]

The teachings of this side of the clan focuses on manipulating the corrosive and acidity of your water release chakra, using your fire release a global dial to determine how lethal the aura you emit can be. You learn to expel this acidic mist from your person at will, temporarily filling a small space, laying waste to anything in your way. You gain the following abilities.

Solid Fog. As an action, you expel a cloud of acidic mist from your person melting anything made of matter. When you do, select the shape of this mist when used. All creatures in the affected area must make a Constitution saving throw vs your highest jutsu save DC. On a failure, they take 1d12 acid damage and one of the following effects of your choosing, or half as much damage on a success. This damage is increased by 1d12 at 7th and 15th levels.

Inflict 1 rank of Corroded or Deteriorate (your choice). This is counted as a Ninjutsu of the highest rank you can cast. This increases by +1 rank at 7th and 15th levels where applicable.

Line: 25-Foot Long, 5 foot wide. Increase in length by +10 feet at 7th and 15th levels.

Cone: 15-Foot Cone. Increase in size by +5 feet at 7th and 15th levels.

Sphere: Select a point you can see within 30 feet, and fill a 10-foot radius sphere, centered on this point. Increase in size by +5 feet at 7th and 15th levels.

Broiling Rampart

1st Level Clan Feature, [Broil Branch]

The Broil Branch has a penchant for heavy strikes and stalwart defenses, having a strong desire for close range fights, by boiling ones chakra, until a mist forms within, building pressure for each strike like a steam engine. While in this Taijutsu stance you gain the following benefits.

You can use your Hijutsu Flexibility ability mod in place of strength for unarmed and weapon attacks.

Beginning at 7th level, if you do not have the Extra Attack class feature, you can attack twice while in this stance when you take the Attack action.

Build Pressure. You can build Pressure, with each strike, or movement. Once per turn, you can gain 1 Pressure when you Dash, Disengage, or cast a Jutsu with the Fire or Water release keywords. You can maintain up to 3 Pressure. You can spend this Pressure on the following. Abilities that would force a saving throw or make an attack uses your highest jutsu save DC or attack bonus. Each of the listed abilities cost 1 Pressure.

Boil Knuckle. On your turn, when your attack result is 5 or higher than the targets AC, you force them to make a Constitution saving throw, being Dazed on a failure.

Jet Dash. You release a halo of steam from your body that propels you like a steam engine. On your turn, increase your speed by +20, and, you release boiling steam at the end of the current turn, forcing adjacent creatures to you to make a Constitution saving throw, becoming Corroded or Scalded on a failure. This ability counts as a Taijutsu of the highest rank you can cast.

Vent Strike. Once per turn, when you deal [Weapon Damage] or [Unarmed Damage], you can increase the damage you deal by +2, until the end of the current turn. This increases to +4 at 7th and +6 at 15th level.

Boiling Synthesis

| Deteriorate / Max Ranks: 5, [Elemental] / A Deteriorating creature suffers the effects of their body and physical form falling apart. / A Deteriorating creature grants attacking creatures a +1 bonus to their critical hit range, for each rank they have. / A creature with 3 or more ranks of Deteriorate loses all Resistances they have. / A creature with 5 ranks of Deteriorate loses all Immunities they have / Creatures that are immune to Acid damage is immune to this condition. / A Deteriorating creature can spend an Action to make a DC 20 Constitution ability check to end this affliction. On a successful check, the condition ends. |

3rd Level Clan Feature

By synergizing with your dual nature releases, you are able to synthesize unique additives to your chakra making highly volatile chakra infusions. Select two of the following infusions. You can switch which infusions you can use when you complete a long rest.

Acidic Mists. Once per turn, as part of casting a jutsu that would inflict ranks of Chilled you can infuse it with an acidic additive. Replacing all ranks of Chilled inflicted with ranks of Deteriorate. Once you use this feature, you cannot do so again until the end of your next turn.

Melting Heat. Once per turn, as part of casting a jutsu that would inflict the Burned condition, you can infuse it with an acidic additive. Replacing all ranks of Burn inflicted with ranks of Scald. Once you use this feature, you cannot do so again until the end of your next turn.

| Scald / Max Ranks: 5, [Elemental] / A Scalding creature suffers the effects of their body and physical form being unable to function to its full potential. / A Scalded creature reduces damage they deal by -2, for each rank they have. / A creature with 3 or more ranks of Scald loses all Temporary Hit Points they have, and cannot gain more. / A creature with 5 ranks of Scald cannot cast jutsu with the Barrier keyword. / Creatures that are immune to Acid damage is immune to this condition. / A Scalded creature can spend an Action to make a DC 20 Constitution ability check to end this affliction. On a successful check, the condition ends. |

Caustic Aura. As a bonus action, you boil your chakra, and begin to emit a haze of steam around you. This steaming aura lasts for 1 minute or until you fail a saving throw vs an effect with the Wind Release keyword, blowing your steam away. While the Steam is active, you reduce the damage you take from bludgeoning, piercing and slashing damage from weapons by an amount equal to half your level, as you corrode and dull their impact on you.

Great Wall Dissolution. Once per turn, as part of dealing [Unarmed Damage] or [Weapon Damage] to a construct, object or structure you wash over it with corrosive chakra. The target must make Constitution saving throw vs your highest jutsu save DC. On a failure, it loses all resistances it has, and gains a vulnerability to Acid damage, and one other damage type of your choice, until the end of your next turn. If the target is a jutsu based effect, you instead make a jutsu ability check, using your highest jutsu modifier, vs the jutsu save DC of the targeted effect. Beginning at 7th level, you gain a rank of Mastery to this check. This increases to two ranks at 11th level and three ranks at 15th level. A creature can only be affected by this ability once, every 10 minutes.

Alchemical Fog

7th Level Clan Feature, [Corrosive Branch]

Nothing stands long when facing you. Even the densest defenses melt like butter to a hot knife when you engage. You gain the second nature release you didn’t select from Boil Release Affinity clan trait and when casting a jutsu with either Water or Fire Release keywords, you can change the damage type to Acid.

You also learn to further harden and solidify your Solid Fog. When you use your Solid Fog, it now persists until the beginning of your next turn. You also learn two alchemical mixtures which allows you to transmute your boil mixture into. You can use one Acid at a time, never able to use two acid effects at the same time as a result of the same trigger. Unless an acid says otherwise, affected creatures must make savings throw vs your highest jutsu save DC. You learn 1 more acids at 11th level.

Curtain of Rain

As a reaction to a hostile creature moving within 15 feet of you, you exhale a Solid Fog, creating a 15-foot radius of haze, centering on you. Select one of its original effects to apply as part of this use. Also, if a hostile creature makes a saving throw vs a Genjutsu with the Inhale keyword while inside the Solid Fog, they make their saving throw at disadvantage.

Perchloric Barrier

As part of casting a jutsu with the Barrier keyword, you weave a potent acid into the threads of chakra that form your shield. Creatures that deal damage as a result of a melee attack to this Barrier must make a Constitution saving throw, gaining 1 rank of Deteriorate for each successful attack against it. This saving throw is made at the end of the current turn.

Clear Lungs

Allied creatures of your choice are unaffected by your Solid Fog’s harmful effects. Additionally, willing allied creatures within a Solid Fog, that has a Physical condition can spend their bonus action(s) to inhale some of the fog. When they do, they can select one of the physical conditions they have and remove all ranks of it. A creature can only remove conditions in this way once, every 10 minutes.

Flower Boil

When a hostile creature moves 10 or more feet into, or through your Solid Fog, they must make a Constitution saving throw. On a failure, they gain 1 rank of Slow. Affected creatures remake their saving throw for every 10 feet they move through the Solid Fog.

Geometric Aerosol

When you use Solid Fog, you can choose to generate two separate shapes at the same time. But they cannot overlap. A Creature can only be affected by one shape per use.

Steam Engine

7th Level Clan Feature, [Broil Branch]

Nothing stands long when facing you. You move like a freight train, and treat people who stand in your way like the casualty they are. You gain the second nature release you didn’t select from Boil Release Affinity clan trait and when casting a jutsu with either Water or Fire Release keywords, you can change the damage type to Acid.

You learn two different steam engine maneuvers which allows you to build and spend more pressure for larger explosive moments. Also, by spending 2 Pressure, you can also enter a unique battle state known as Torque for 1 minute, once per rest. If a maneuver requires a saving throw, you use your highest jutsu save DC. You learn 1 more maneuver at 11th level.

Horse Power

| #### Torque / Battle Amp / Each step fires a steam piston within you, building pressure; / Higher Horsepower. You can maintain up to 6 Pressure at once. / Piston Break. You can build up to 2 Pressure per turn, instead of one. |

While you are benefiting from Torque, you can enhance its benefits, offensively by spending 1 Pressure at the beginning of your turn. Until the end of your turn, your unarmed attacks and Weapon attacks, gain the Deadly 2 weapon property. This increases to Deadly 4 at 15th level.

Piston

You can Dash, as a reaction on your turn, or by spending your reaction in response to a hostile creature moving away from you, you can move up to your movement speed closer to them. When you Dash, you can spend 2 Pressure to make your movement immune to attack of opportunities. In addition, once per turn, creatures of your choice that you pass by within 5 feet of you as part of your Dashes movement, must make a Strength saving throw, being Dazed, and knocked Prone on a failure.

Steam Burst

When you score a hit with a melee attack or a hostile creature fails a saving throw as a result of a Hijutsu you cast, you can spend 2 Pressure to offload a large volume of steam, forcing them, and all creatures within 10 feet of you to make a Dexterity saving throw. On a failure, they gain 2 ranks of Scald.

Melting Strike

When you deal damage to a hostile creature that is Corroded or Burned you can spend 2 Pressure.

When you do, you convert Corroded into ranks of Scald equal to the rank of Corroded they currently have, as they lose the Corroded condition. (D-Rank: 1 Rank, C-Rank: 2 Ranks, B-Rank: 3 Ranks, A-Rank: 4 Ranks, S-Rank: 5 Ranks)

Alternatively, you convert an equal number of Burned into Scald.

Redline

When you fail a saving throw against a hostile effect, you can spend up to 6 remaining Pressure, gaining a +2 bonus to the failed save for each Pressure spent. Once you use this feature you cannot do so again until at least 10 minutes have passed.

Sauna of Lies

11th Level Clan Feature

Your presence is a constant reminder to your foes, that lies are to be punished. Those that try, can feel the heat when they do.

While in a social encounter, you can select one creature to turn the heat up on. When you do, you passively release an aura of steam, invisible to the naked eye that turns the temperature up on them.

When the select creature makes a Charisma check vs you or your allies, you can spend your reaction to turn up the heat, imposing a 1d4 penalty to their check. You can use this feature twice per social encounter.

Perfect Solution

15th Level Clan Feature, [Corrosive Branch]

You radiate a corrosive aura so potent, creatures within your vicinity can sense their defenses failing them as a result of your very presence.

While in combat, hostile creatures that end their turn within 15 feet of you, must make a Constitution saving throw vs your Highest jutsu save DC. On a failure, their AC is reduced by 1, for the next minute. A creature that passes this saving throw by 10 or more gains immunity to it until you complete a rest.

Additionally, jutsu cast by hostile creatures with the Barrier keyword within 15 feet of you, that rolls dice to determine their effects or hit points, roll half their listed value.

Catastrophic Vent

15th Level Clan Feature, [Broil Branch]

You can release stored pressure, in a single violent purge, pushing you and your body into a state of extreme Torque.

When you enter Torque, you gain the following additional benefits for the duration;

You gain +4 DR.

You gain 2 ranks of Mastery to Athletics and Acrobatics checks.

Hijutsu you cast that requires concentration, gains the Stable and Efficient keywords.

You gain immunity to the Dazed and Staggered conditions.
